component.name: Nuage
component.summary: Your cloud storage as a regular folder

description.p: Nuage shows your cloud storage accounts as folders of your home, like any other folder: files open in your usual applications and are downloaded only when you use them. Changes are uploaded in the background.

ul.li: Set up an account in a few screens, signed in through your browser
See what is syncing, pause and resume uploads
Browse, upload, move and share files, even when an account is not mounted
Keep folders or patterns out of the sync
Google Docs open in your web browser

description.p: Nuage uses rclone. Google Drive is supported; your own Google sign-in client keeps your access private to you.
First version: Google Drive and local folders, mounted with rclone.
